reviews.title: Non stop ads!
reviews.text:
Every single time you open the app it pops up asking if you want to become a pro member for an extortionate fee, every single time! Then when using the remote (probably clicking the directions as you scroll), ads pop up, about 10 seconds in total before a skip, but the nature of clicking your phone whilst looking at the screen inevitably means you will click these ads. Its honestly just nasty business practices, Amazon have gone so dramatically down hill over the past few years its incredible.

Avoid unless you absolutely need it for a short term use!

reviews.title: Great if not for constant ads interrupting use 🤬
reviews.text: I found this app after misplacing my remote and initially thought it was brilliant….however, since finding the remote and it now not working, the app is getting more use and therefore noticing the BIG issue: in the middle of looking for something, or typing in a password (anything that requires more than a few taps), an ad will take over, so you’re either forced to watch it, or shut it down and restart. It is INFURIATING!!!!!!! If this is a bonefide Prime remote app, surely you’ve paid enough to at least have a remote that doesn’t include ads on top of all the ads you’re forced to watch without being able to fast forward through them?! Am I missing something or are the constant efforts to keep taking money from everyone preventing any simple pleasures from being free?

reviews.title: Invalid contact! Bad connection!
reviews.text:
I have been trying to email them to cancel my subscription, but the form provided doesn’t work! It won’t submit my message, so I have no way of contacting the seller in order to stop my subscription! This is so ridiculous and unprofessional! 
Also, the app remote keeps disconnecting if not used for five minutes or longer, and I have to connect it again every time I need to do a simple command - very inconvenient! 
It helped a little when I lost my actual remote, but it’s not a good app! And there NO CONTACTS or feedback!

reviews.title: Why is this a subscription? Should just be a one time flat price
reviews.text:
App works ok. Just need it to supplement our broken remote in the mean time. The fact that they want to charge me a monthly fee in hopes I forget I’m paying, is absolute trash. New physical remotes cost around 8 bucks, and this should be at least 2 bucks less than that. I’d be totally fine with that.

My real beef is with the trial version, the ad pops up every time I try to fast forward through an actual commercial. Perfect timing, every-time. How about instead, every time I open the app I just watch your ad instead of every time I interact with it. The greed is repulsive.
